address: 262/8 Yaowarat Road, Talat Yai, Mueang Phuket, Phuket, 83000, Thailand
bio: This outlet with a red-brown zinc roof offers a menu of both individual and sharing dishes, with nicely balanced flavours. Despite its humble guise, Sang Ka Sri attracts a crowd, so be prepared to wait for a table before enjoying the fresh squid with herbs and tangy dressing....
